# QA-only spreadsheet libraries

These files are pinned copies of the same browser distributions already loaded by `mockups/operations-hub/index.html`. They are used only by the local functional XLSX/ZIP tests; they add no application runtime or npm dependency.

- `jszip-3.10.1.min.js` — [jszip@3.10.1 browser build](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jszip@3.10.1/dist/jszip.min.js), MIT license in `LICENSE-jszip-3.10.1.txt`, SHA-256 `ACC7E41455A80765B5FD9C7EE1B8078A6D160BBBCA455AEAE854DE65C947D59E`.
- `xlsx-0.18.5.full.min.js` — [xlsx@0.18.5 browser build](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xlsx@0.18.5/dist/xlsx.full.min.js), Apache-2.0 license in `LICENSE-xlsx-0.18.5.txt`, SHA-256 `C9506197CAF809A075B6DEE1DA0D36FB19DA7158FFE8A88E7B0C96C5D8623C99`.
